description: This file defines helper templates and functions to facilitate safer memory access in the incfs support subsystem. It includes mechanisms for detecting function return types, handling memory access errors gracefully, and providing a safer alternative to macros for memory access error handling.

classes.name: func_result
classes.description: A template alias to deduce the result type of a callable when invoked with a given argument.
classes.additional_details: Removes const, volatile, and reference qualifiers from the deduced return type.

classes.name: optional_result
classes.description: A template alias that resolves to std::optional of the function's return type, or bool if the function is void, facilitating safe error handling during memory access.

methods.name: optional_result<Ptr,F> access(Ptr ptr,F && accessor)
methods.description: A template function that executes a memory access closure safely within a signal bus handler context, returning an optional result or status indicating success or failure.

ctags.name: access
ctags.pattern: /^auto access(Ptr ptr, F&& accessor) -> optional_result<Ptr, F> {$/
